title: Equity Brief — 20 Nov 2026
intro: Global equities face a severe risk-off session during the Europe-New York overlap as a panic-driven sell-off sweeps across all major asset classes. Markets are gripped by acute fear, sending the VIX soaring 9.04 percent to 31.01 while major indices plummet over two percent.

sections.heading: Today's calendar (CET)
sections.content:
- 🟠 08:00 · GBP Retail Sales m/m · (f 0.0% · p -0.4%)
- 🟠 09:15 · EUR ECB President Lagarde Speaks
- 🟠 16:00 · USD Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment · (f 51.7 · p 51.0)
- 🟠 16:00 · USD Revised UoM Inflation Expectations · (f · · p 4.3%)

sections.heading: Equity theme
sections.content: The dominant driver is a relentless macroeconomic and geopolitical rout compounded by massive tech sector liquidation, ongoing U.S.-China tensions, and ballooning regulatory and legal exposures for semiconductor leaders. Safe-haven demand is visible as US 10Y yields drop 7.6bp to 4.976 percent.

sections.heading: Leaders & laggards
sections.content: All major indices and mega caps are sliding severely with a breadth of 0/8 higher among mega caps. Apple leads the mega caps with a relatively mild drop of 0.92 percent to 349.21, while Amazon lags severely, plunging 3.87 percent to 257.37 alongside Nvidia dropping 3.30 percent to 145.98.

sections.heading: Europe & Asia
sections.content: European and Asian equities are heavily bloodied, led by the KOSPI plunging 5.21 percent to 4,869.96 and Nikkei 225 tumbling 5.06 percent to 56,437. In Europe, DAX drops 2.43 percent to 24,844 and Euro Stoxx 50 sinks 2.46 percent to 5,963.71.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▼ Bearish · S&P 500 — below 7,100.00 opens 6,850.00 · invalid above 7,250.00*
Broad-based liquidation accelerates as the index breaches crucial psychological support levels.
- *▲ Bullish · Apple — above 355.00 opens 370.00 · invalid below 340.00*
Relative outperformance compared to peers attracts bargain hunters seeking mega-cap safety.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Escalating U.S.-China trade and tech tensions following Trump's return from Asia.
- Unchecked volatility expansion threatening broader systemic liquidity.
